categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing of printed circuit boards (PCBs) and automotive seat covers. It also provides electronic manufacturing services (EMS) including SMT processing and electronic component assembly. Recently, it expanded into automotive seat cover manufacturing through acquisition and spun off its PCB manufacturing division to enhance specialization.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including multi-layer and high-density thin PCBs, SMT processing, and electronic component assembly. It focuses on automotive electronic parts, telecommunications, and network PCBs, employing capital-intensive and rapidly evolving technology. For automotive seat covers, it uses specialized materials like leather and TPU with skilled sewing and quilting processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major automotive companies such as Hyundai Mobis and Kia Motors, as well as telecommunications and electronic component manufacturers. The PCB products serve automotive electronics, information communication, and network industries, while the automotive seat covers are supplied to first-tier automotive suppliers. The company targets domestic markets predominantly, with some export sales mainly in PCBs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with manufacturing facilities in Incheon and Cheongju. It serves domestic customers primarily but also engages in indirect exports internationally, including to foreign companies and export agents. Its supply chain and sales are largely focused on the Korean market with some global exposure through exports.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream manufacturing segment of the supply chain, producing PCBs and automotive seat covers as components for larger original equipment manufacturers (OEMs). It acts as a first or second-tier supplier to automotive OEMs and electronics companies, focusing on component fabrication and assembly rather than raw material extraction or final product assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding high-value multi-layer and ultra-multi-layer PCB sales, enhancing technology for automotive electronics, and diversifying into automotive seat cover manufacturing to improve profitability. The company invests in R&D to improve product quality and develop new automotive electronic components, while also exploring new business areas such as digital content and secondary battery materials, though these are in early stages.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of PCBs, automotive seat covers, and EMS services. Sales are mostly order-based with domestic and export customers, involving direct product delivery and invoicing with payment terms. The company also generates minor revenue from by-product sales and has begun to diversify revenue streams through acquisitions and new business segments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the domestic PCB market, the company is a mid-sized player with an estimated 1-2% market share, competing with larger firms like Samsung Electro-Mechanics, Daeduck Electronics, and Simtek. In automotive seat covers, it supplies to major OEMs through first-tier suppliers, competing on quality and technological capability. The company emphasizes technological superiority and quality certifications to maintain competitive positioning.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated sales of approximately 140.9 billion KRW in 2023, a 31% increase from the previous year, driven by growth in automotive PCBs and seat covers. Despite revenue growth, it recorded an operating loss of 1.8 billion KRW and a net loss of 10 billion KRW due to impairments and investment losses. Total assets stood at about 95 billion KRW, with a moderate decrease from the prior year, and equity increased slightly to 32.2 billion KRW.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced multi-layer PCB manufacturing capabilities tailored for automotive electronics and telecommunications, emphasizing high quality and reliability. Its automotive seat covers focus on eco-friendly, high-sensitivity materials contributing to driver comfort and safety, supported by quality certifications like SQ 'S' grade. The firm aims to leverage technological innovation and diversified product offerings to enhance customer satisfaction and secure stable revenue streams.
